part_no.description: Current internal identifier assigned to the manufactured or sellable item.

part_desc.description: User-facing text that describes the item.

base_uom.description: Unit code used to stock and count the item.

plant_cd.description: Plant or site code that owns this item record.

rev_lvl.description: Released engineering change level for the item design.

drawing_ref.description: Document identifier for the item's controlled drawing.

lot_ctrl_flag.description: True when inventory must be traced by production lot.

serial_ctrl_flag.description: True when every physical unit requires a unique serial identifier.

net_wt.description: Mass of the item excluding packaging.

gross_wt.description: Mass of the item including packaging.

wt_uom.description: Unit code used by both recorded mass values.

std_cost.description: Planned valuation price per stocked unit.

currency_cd.description: Currency code for the planned valuation price.

procure_type.description: Code indicating whether replenishment is made internally, purchased, or both.

lead_time_days.description: Calendar days expected between replenishment request and availability.

safety_stock_qty.description: Protected inventory quantity held to absorb demand variation.

product_family_cd.description: Assortment and reporting group assigned to the item.

planner_id.description: Person or team code that controls material planning.

legacy_part_no.description: Superseded item identifier retained only for historical lookup.

vendor_material_ref.description: Supplier catalog identifier for the item, not the internal item key.
